# Menu settings

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:settings` from mod-source/src/core/menu/content. Don't edit by hand. -->

Every setting in the Falcon menu (press **Esc** in game), by tab. Each entry shows the setting's id (what
the code and exported settings files use), its kind, its default and the menu's own description.
Settings nested under another one open from that setting's arrow or gear button.

The **Favorites** tab lists the settings you starred; **Credits** has no settings.

## Combat

- **Combat Modules** (group) — General purpose combat modules grouped up to clean up the menu interface.
  - **Velocity Hits** (`velocityHits`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically strikes enemies if they will run into spikes.
  - **Knockback Hits** (`attackFactoringKB:hits`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically strikes enemies factoring knocking potential.
  - **Accurate Enemy Shame** (`accurateEnemyShame`, toggle, default: on) — Counts an enemy's heal toward their shame only when it looks like food (20+ health, or 16+ to full health). Off: every heal counts, including healing pads and regen hats/accessories, which push the count wrong. Shame Grinder, Shame Strike, One Tick and Apple Insta read this count.
  - **Trust Seen Weapons** (`trustSeenWeapons`, toggle, default: off) — Keeps an enemy's hunting bow or crossbow (and its reload) once seen, instead of assuming a loaded musket whenever they hold their primary. Guesses a katana, not a polearm, for a short sword. Off: the old worst-case guesses.
  - **Knockback Instakills** (`attackFactoringKB:insta`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically instakills enemies factoring knocking potential.
    - **Allow While Trapped** (`attackFactoringKB:insta:allowInTrap`, toggle, default: off) — Lets these instakills run while you are trapped, as long as Auto Breaker has no spikes to break around you.
    - **Insta Uses Enemy Health** (`instaUsesEnemyHealth`, toggle, default: off) — Also runs the insta when its two hits together (soldier helmet assumed for the second) reach the enemy's current health. Off: only when spikes, a pit trap or 100+ damage in one tick finish them, so a hurt enemy is often left alone. An enemy who heals between the two hits survives.
  - **Musket Insta** (`musketInsta`, toggle, default: off) — With polearm + musket: bull helmet + polearm, then turret gear + musket, when the damage kills the nearest enemy at its current health (assuming soldier helmet for the second hit).
    - **Katana + musket** (`musketInsta:katana`, toggle, default: on) — Also runs the combo with katana + musket, using the katana's damage (40) and shorter reach (118).
  - **EMP-Aware Instas** (`empAwareInstas`, toggle, default: off) — Musket Insta and Knockback Instakills leave out the turret bullet when the enemy wears an EMP Helmet (it blocks turret damage), so they don't fire an insta that can't kill. Off: the turret's 25 is always counted.
  - **Auto Push Strikes** (`attackInPush`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically attacks enemies during auto pushing once collision is made with a spike.
    - **Dagger Shame Strike Threshold** (`daggerShameStrikeThres`, slider 2–7, default: 4) — Shame Strike waits until the enemy's shame count reaches this number.
    - **Dagger Attack Method** (`attackInPush:dagger_method`, select, default: Shame Strike) — Determines what method to use to attack enemies when our primary weapon is daggers. Shame Strike method makes the mod wait for enemies to gain a high shameCount before attacking with turret. Bullspam method makes the mod do constant brute force attacking. Disabled makes the mod do nothing. Options: Shame Strike / Bullspam / Disabled.
    - **High Damage Attack Method** (`attackInPush:polearm_katana_method`, select, default: Predictive) — Determines what method to use to attack enemies when our primary weapon is either polearm or katana. Predictive method makes mod try to sync the attacks with enemies' tank gear equip. Bullspam method makes the mod do constant brute force bullspamming. Disabled makes the mod do nothing. Options: Predictive / Bullspam / Disabled.
    - **Generic Attack Method** (`attackInPush:generic_method`, select, default: Bullspam) — Determines what method to use to attack enemies for any other primary weapon. Bullspam method makes the mod do constant brute force bullspamming. Disabled makes the mod do nothing. Options: Bullspam / Disabled.
    - **Turret Bullet Assist** (`turretBulletAssistOnAP`, toggle, default: on) — Uses turret gear to attack pit-spiked enemies if other attack methods are unavailable.
  - **Pit-Spike Breaker** (`objectBreaker:pit_spike`, toggle, default: off) — Automatically breaks objects near traps to accelerate pit-spiking. If you used Chicken V3, you'll have a more clear idea of what this does. Requires Object Breaker to be enabled for this to work.
  - **Projectile Sync** (`projectileSync`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically attacks enemies the moment it can onetick with any projectile.
  - **Turret Gear Knockback** (`turretGearKB`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically uses turret gear's knockback to kill enemies if possible.
  - **Barbarian Knockback** (`barbKnockback`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically uses barbarian armor if the knockback kills the enemy.
- **Spike Oneshots** (group) — Modules that customize oneshots using spikes
  - **Shame Grind** (`shameGrind`, toggle, default: off) — While the enemy is trapped, fakes Apple Insta with bull hits so they eat too fast and gain shame. Lets Apple Insta finish once they're shamed (can't heal) or stop eating right after hits, or after 12 fakes. Needs a great hammer, Apple Insta, Auto Place and Preplacements.
  - **Apple Insta** (`appleInsta`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically breaks enemy traps and spike one shots them. Requires preplacements module to be turned on.
    - **Allow While Trapped** (`appleInstaWhileTrapped`, toggle, default: on) — Triggers even when trapped.
    - **Allow Low Damage Primaries** (`appleAllowsLowDamagePri`, toggle, default: on) — Triggers even for daggers, bat, etc.
  - **Spike Tick** (`spikeTick`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically spike instakills enemies when trap breaks.
- **Auto Place** (`autoPlacing`, toggle, default: off) — Automatically places buildings quickly and efficiently.
  - **Range** (`autoPlaceRange`, slider 100–1200, default: 400) — How close the nearest enemy must be before Auto Place starts placing traps.
  - **Angle Finder Level** (`angleFinderLevel`, slider 1–10, default: 7) — Determines the levels of budget the angle finder has. The higher it is, the more accurate angles become. This toggle also affects defensive modules.
  - **Two Tick Placements** (`twoTickPlacements`, toggle, default: off) — Automatic placements occur every two game ticks instead of one. Reduces packet usage, makes placement less 'spammy', but reduces overall placement effectiveness.
  - **Preplacements** (`preplacer`, toggle, default: on) — Preemptively places buildings in places where buildings are about to break.
  - **Replacements** (`replacer`, toggle, default: on) — Places buildings once it receives a killObject packet from the game server.
- **Melee Sync** (`meleeSync`, toggle, default: off) — Automatically melee syncs with allies on targets with primary weapon. For this to work correctly, the person you want to sync with must choose to sync with you as well. Which means that this toggle will generally NOT work with non-falcon users.
  - **Sync With** (`meleeSyncTarget`, number -1–50, default: -1, not saved) — Select ANY player to sync with via their in-game SID. To sync with no one, set the value to -1.
- **Aim Assist** (`aimAssist`, toggle, default: off) — When you hit by hand (mouse click tank spam, or E auto-gather with "Aim With Mouse While Gathering"), turns your swing to an enemy inside a cone around your mouse. Never outside the cone (at most 60° wide), never teammates or dead players. Melee aims at the enemy's centre; musket, crossbow and bow aim where the enemy will be when the shot arrives. L locks on to the current target (kept while it stays in the cone); J switches to the next enemy in the cone.
  - **Cone Width (FOV)** (`aimAssist:fov`, slider 10–60, default: 40) — How wide the cone around your mouse is, in degrees (all of it, not each side). 60 at most.
  - **Max Distance** (`aimAssist:maxDist`, slider 100–1400, default: 700) — Enemies farther away than this are never picked.
  - **Pick** (`aimAssist:pick`, select, default: Nearest) — Which enemy in the cone to aim at. Options: Nearest / Lowest Health / Closest To Mouse.
  - **Lead Falcon's Ranged Shots** (`aimAssist:leadOwnShots`, toggle, default: off) — Falcon's own attacks aimed at the nearest enemy (instas and the like) aim a musket, crossbow or bow shot where the enemy will be, not where it is. Off = aim straight at the enemy, as before.
  - **Show Markers** (`aimAssist:markers`, toggle, default: on) — Draws a ring on the current target (yellow, red while locked) and a dot where a ranged shot is aimed.
- **Dynamic One Tick** (`dynamicOneTick`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically does one ticks whenever possible. This toggle must be turned on for 'Active' oneTick mode to work.
  - **Ignore Hats** (`oneTickIgnoreHats`, toggle, default: off) — Leaves the enemy's Soldier, Tank and EMP Helmet damage reduction out when deciding if a one tick kills.
- **Auto Push** (`autoPush`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically pushes enemies into spikes.
  - **Range** (`autoPushRange`, slider 100–300, default: 250) — How close a trapped enemy must be before Auto Push starts pushing them.
  - **Render Pathfinding Line** (`renderAutoPushingPathfindingLine`, toggle, default: on) — Draws the path Auto Push is following.
- **Anti Bull** (`antiBull`, toggle, default: off) — Counters bullspamming by using Spike Gear and CX Wings. This toggle completely overrides Shadow Wings.
  - **Force Spike Gear** (`forceAntiBull`, toggle, default: on) — Force equips Spike Gear in situations where enemies cannot do non-soldier vulnerable counter attacks (e.g. spikeTick).
  - **Keep On at High Shame** (`antiBullHighShame`, toggle, default: on) — Keeps Anti Bull working when your shame is 4 or more, which is when bull spam hurts most. A due bull tick still comes first. Off: Anti Bull stands down from 4 shame, as before.

## Utility

- **Farming / Store Utilities** (group) — Modules that help automate the annoying parts of the store and grinding.
  - **Auto Grinding** (`autoGrind`, toggle, default: off, not saved) — Helps with leveling up weapons to higher variants.
    - **Primary Limit** (`grindPrimaryLimit`, slider 0–3, default: 2) — Set the limit of primary grinding.
    - **Secondary Limit** (`grindSecondaryLimit`, slider 0–3, default: 1) — Set the limit of secondary grinding.
  - **Auto Buy** (`autoBuy`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically purchases hats and accessories.
    - **Fight-First Order** (`autoBuy:fightFirst`, toggle, default: off) — Buys fight hats first (Monkey Tail, Soldier, Bull, Booster, EMP...) and picks up cheaper items while saving for an expensive one. Also buys Angel Wings and Blood Wings. Off: the original order, one item at a time.
  - **Auto Upgrade** (`autoUpgrade`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically upgrades weapons and items.
    - **7th Slot** (`7thSlot`, select, default: Teleport) — Set what the Auto Upgrader picks for the 7th slot. Options: Teleport / Turret / Healing Pad / Blocker / Platform.
    - **Age 2 Pick** (`upgradeAge2`, select, default: Manual) — Your primary weapon at age 2. Manual: you pick (Auto Upgrade used to leave this age to you). Options: Manual / Hand Axe / Short Sword / Polearm / Bat / Daggers / Stick.
    - **Age 6 Pick** (`upgradeAge6`, select, default: Manual) — Your secondary weapon at age 6. Manual: you pick. Options: Manual / Hunting Bow / Great Hammer / Wooden Shield / McGrabby.
    - **Age 8 Pick** (`upgradeAge8`, select, default: Manual) — At age 8 (each needs what it upgrades: great axe the hand axe, katana the short sword, crossbow the hunting bow, power mill the faster windmill). Manual: you pick. Options: Manual / Great Axe / Katana / Crossbow / Power Mill.
    - **Age 9 Pick** (`upgradeAge9`, select, default: Manual) — At age 9 (repeater and musket need the crossbow, poison and spinning spikes the greater spikes). Manual: you pick. Options: Manual / Repeater Crossbow / Musket / Poison Spikes / Spinning Spikes / Spawn Pad.
    - **Spend Every Point** (`upgradeSpendAll`, toggle, default: off) — Never leave an upgrade point unspent: when an age's pick isn't offered it takes the first offered upgrade (buildings before weapons); an age set to Manual is picked the same way when only buildings are offered, or after the wait below when weapons are and you haven't picked.
    - **Manual Pick Wait** (`upgradeManualWait`, slider 3–30, default: 10) — With Spend Every Point: seconds to wait for your own pick at a Manual age before Auto Upgrade picks.
- **Packet Management** (group) — Customize modules to modify the client's method for managing packet usage.
  - **Packet Budget Strictness** (`packetBudgetStrictness`, slider 2–4, default: 2) — Sets how many ticks ahead the budget tracker reserves packets.
  - **Packet Budget Limit** (`packetBudgetLimit`, slider 100–110, default: 110) — Determines the maximum capacity for packet usage.
  - **Send Movement Instantly** (`sendMovementInstantly`, toggle, default: off) — Sends a new walking direction the moment you press or release a movement key, instead of with the next server tick (about 55 ms sooner on average). Only while your keys steer (not during one ticks or auto push), Safe Walk still applies, and it waits for the next tick as before when the packet budget is full.
  - **Jitter-Safe Timing** (`jitterSafeTiming`, toggle, default: off) — When your ping jumps around, leaves room for it in the three timings that use ping: preplacements are sent later by the jitter (late still places, early fails), the check that a heal of ours was food waits longer, and the packet budget counts older packets a little longer. No effect on a steady connection.
  - **Artificial Ping** (`artificialPing`, toggle, default: off, not saved) — Artificially increases ping. This toggle does actually make your ping worse. Unlike with other toggles, this toggle will not be automatically saved.
    - **Artificial Amount** (`artificialPingAmt`, slider 10–80, default: 35) — Extra delay added to your connection, in ms (half on sending, half on receiving).
- **Auto Break** (`autoBreak`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically breaks buildings while trapped.
  - **Break Traps From Any Angle** (`trapBreakAnyAngle`, toggle, default: off) — While trapped, turns the swing to hit as many enemy spikes and traps at once as possible (a swing hits everything in reach within about 69 degrees of the aim), while still hitting every enemy spike and trap the usual aim hits. Avoids hitting your own buildings when it can. Only while trapped.
- **Auto Respawn** (`autoRespawn`, toggle, default: off) — Automatically respawns when you die.
- **Aim With Mouse While Gathering** (`mouseAimWhileGathering`, toggle, default: off) — With auto-gather on (E), swings toward your mouse. Off: Falcon doesn't send your mouse direction in normal play, so the swings go wherever it was last aiming.
- **Kill Chat** (`killChat`, toggle, default: off) — Automatically chats something whenever your killCount increases.
- **Auto Play** (`autoPlay`, toggle, default: off) — Auto play? Might as well, the whole client basically does everything for you. Now let's automate movement too! Requires you to enable all the other modules for this to be good.
  - **Follow** (`followTo`, number -1–500, default: -1, not saved) — Follow ANY player with via their in-game SID. To follow with no one, set the value to -1.

## Defense

- **Defense System** (group) — Manage the mod's main defensive system.
  - **Pattern Recognition** (`usePatternRec`, toggle, default: on) — Adapts defensive calculations based on common enemy attack patterns.
  - **Auto Healing** (`autoHeal`, toggle, default: on) — Responds to dangers by auto healing.
    - **Shame-Safe Healing** (`shameSafeHealing`, toggle, default: off) — At 7 shame, doesn't eat within 120 ms of a hit: in 1.8.2 that food would reach 8 shame, lock eating for 30 s and not even heal. It waits for the next tick instead, when eating lowers shame.
    - **Exact Threat Reload** (`exactThreatReload`, toggle, default: off) — Counts an enemy weapon's damage for the next tick only when it is fully reloaded now, which is exactly when its hit can land next tick. Off: counts it from 90% reloaded, which sometimes counts a slow weapon a tick early (extra heals and soldier helmets for nothing). On a laggy server a fast weapon can very rarely be a tick sooner than counted.
    - **Resync Predicted Speed** (`resyncPredictedSpeed`, toggle, default: off) — Starts each tick's prediction of where you'll be with your real speed. Off (classic): the speed is kept from the last prediction, so after one predicted spike bounce Falcon thinks you hit the spike every tick, and Auto Heal eats right after hits (+1 shame each time) for damage that never comes.
    - **Exact Break Hit Count** (`exactBreakHits`, toggle, default: off) — Counts how many hits break a trap or spike exactly: one whose health is an exact multiple of a hit's damage breaks on that hit. Off: counts one hit too many in that case (the classic count). Used by the Hat System (can a trapped dagger enemy get out) and Auto Breaker.
  - **Hat Switching** (`defensiveHatSwitching`, toggle, default: on) — Allows the action of hat switching to mitigate potential damages.
  - **Classic Hat Switching** (`classicHatSwitching`, toggle, default: off) — Everyday hats like a classic MooMoo hat changer: Soldier Helmet with an enemy within 300, else Flipper Hat in the river, Winter Cap in the snow, Booster Hat while moving, Soldier Helmet when still. Combos, defense, bull ticks, EMP and breaking hats work as before.
  - **Remember Sent Equips** (`rememberSentEquips`, toggle, default: off) — Doesn't send the same hat or accessory again while the last one is still on its way to the server (useful above ~110 ms ping). Saves packets and lets the accessory go out sooner. Which items are worn doesn't change.
  - **Blood Wings Optimizations** (`bloodWingsOptimizations`, toggle, default: off) — While hurt, wears Blood Wings for melee hits on enemies (heals 20% of the damage, without shame). At 4+ shame, Auto Heal lets such a hit heal instead of eating.
  - **Angel Wings Regen** (`angelWingsRegen`, toggle, default: off) — While hurt and no enemy is close, wears Angel Wings (3 health a second, without shame) instead of Monkey Tail.
- **Safe Walk** (`safeWalk`, toggle, default: on) — Prevents walking into dangerous or annoying buildings.
  - **Ignore My Teleports** (`safeWalkIgnoreMyTps`, toggle, default: on) — Safe walk doesn't stop you from walking into your own teleports.
  - **Ignore Allied Boost Pads** (`safeWalkIgnoreAllyBoostPads`, toggle, default: on) — Safe walk doesn't stop you from walking into boost pads placed by allies.
- **Always Pick Best Weapon** (`selectBestWeapon`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically selects the best weapon for every scenario.
- **Auto Object Breaker** (`walkBreaker`, toggle, default: on) — Automatically breaks spikes, traps, and teleports.
  - **Closest First** (`walkBreaker:closestFirst`, toggle, default: off) — When several enemy buildings are in reach: spikes first, then the closest, then the one with the least health. Off = the classic order (spikes first, the rest as stored).
  - **Detection Range** (`walkBreaker:detectRange`, slider 0–300, default: 0) — How much farther than your weapon's reach the breaker looks for enemy buildings. It still only swings at buildings in real reach. 0 = classic (only buildings in reach).
  - **Walk To Targets** (`walkBreaker:walkToTarget`, toggle, default: off) — Walks towards an enemy building in Detection Range until it is in reach: spikes first, then the closest, then the one with the least health. Only while you aren't moving yourself, Shift isn't held and no enemy player is within 300. Needs Detection Range above 0.
  - **Show Range** (`walkBreaker:showRange`, toggle, default: off) — Draws your break reach (white) and Detection Range (yellow) around you, and marks the building being hit (red) or walked to (yellow).
- **Defensive Knockbacks** (`defensiveKB`, toggle, default: on) — Uses highly 'advanced' complex spatial trigonometry to determine perfect knockback vectors to knock enemies away for defensive purposes.
  - **Require Turret Bullet** (`defKBRequireTurret`, toggle, default: on) — Only executes defensive knockbacks only when primary AND turret is fully reloaded.

## Visual

- **Building Visuals** (group) — Modules that customizes visuals relating to buildings.
  - **Building Health Bars** (`buildingHealthBar`, toggle, default: on) — Draws health bars on buildings.
    - **Always Show** (`buildingHealthAlwaysShow`, toggle, default: off) — Render health bars regardless if the object has taken damage or not.
  - **Draw Building Overlay** (`buildingOverlay`, toggle, default: on) — Draws indicators that tell if a building is friendly or not.
- **Original MooMoo Artwork** (`originalArtwork`, toggle, default: on) — On sandbox.moomodding.io, draws hats, accessories, weapons and arrows with the official MooMoo.io pictures (the look of the original Falcon), not moomodding's redrawn ones. The hotbar keeps the site's pictures. Takes effect after a page reload.
- **Debugging Visuals** (group) — Modules that help with debugging the mod's features.
  - **Render Placement** (`renderPlacements`, toggle, default: on) — Draws ghost objects to where we'll place.
  - **Render Packet Count** (`renderPacketCounter`, toggle, default: on) — Draws a packet counter on top of the player.
  - **Show Activity** (`showActivity`, toggle, default: on) — Displays a live list of active modules and behaviors.
  - **Hat Debug** (`showHatDecision`, toggle, default: off) — Shows which hat and accessory the Hat System wants this tick, and which of its rules chose them.
  - **Render Ownership** (`renderOwnership`, toggle, default: on) — Draws the unqiue sid values on both players and game objects.
  - **Render Placement Times** (`renderPlacementTime`, toggle, default: on) — Shows runtimes for the 6 most recent placements.
  - **Render Real Direction** (`renderRealDir`, toggle, default: on) — Renders the real direction of our player.
- **Render Grid** (`renderGrid`, toggle, default: on) — Draws the background grid.
  - **Static Grid** (`staticGrid`, toggle, default: off) — Makes the grid not resize with zoom.
- **Night Mode** (`nightMode`, toggle, default: off) — Renders a darker tint on the screen.
- **Reload Bars** (`reloadBars`, toggle, default: on) — Draws reload bars.
  - **Render Turret Gear Reload** (`renderTurretReload`, toggle, default: off) — Shows a reload bar next to players while their Turret Gear is reloading.
  - **Reload HUD** (`reloadBars:hud`, toggle, default: off) — Shows a panel on the left of the screen with your primary and secondary reload and the nearest enemy's, with the server ticks left until each is ready. A "?" after an enemy weapon means it is a guess (not seen yet). Grey means that weapon isn't held, so it isn't reloading: the ticks count down once it is held again.
- **Shame Counter** (`renderShameCounter`, toggle, default: on) — Draws a entities' shame count.
- **Stacked Text** (`stackedText`, toggle, default: off) — Damage and healing text are merged.
- **Render Names** (`renderNames`, toggle, default: on) — Draws player and ai names.

## Console


## Configs

- **Development Analytics** (`improvementLogging`, toggle, default: on) — Nothing is sent anywhere. While this is on, a packet log (.fpl) is only saved when you die if Download Local Copy is on; while it is off, one is saved on every death.
  - **Download Local Copy** (`improvementLoggingLCopy`, toggle, default: off) — Saves the last 15 seconds of packets as an .fpl file each time you die.
- **Combat Debug Log** (`combatDebugLog`, toggle, default: off) — Writes combat details to the browser console (F12): each swing seen (who, weapon, its reload time) and how many server ticks the reload took. For testing only; leave it off while playing.
- **Auto Save Configs** (`autoSaveSettings`, toggle, default: off) — Automatically saves setting configurations to local storage.

## Experimentals

- **preplacer dont round** (`prenorounding`, toggle, default: off, not saved) — makes preplace not round timing to the nearest int.
